name: @tejpratap/nl-to-regex
description: Translate English descriptions into valid JavaScript RegExp objects, using a fast offline template engine.
author: Tej Pratap Singh <tejpratap46@gmail.com>

scripts.copy:grammar: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.mkdirSync('dist/providers/grammar', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('src/providers/grammar/language.generated.js', 'dist/providers/grammar/language.generated.js'); fs.cpSync('src/providers/grammar/language.generated.d.ts', 'dist/providers/grammar/language.generated.d.ts');"
scripts.build: npm run compile:jison && tsc -p . && npm run copy:grammar
